findings.issue: The “Products below reactants” row reverses both the energy-change sign and the reaction classification. It should say “ΔE negative: exothermic,” not “ΔE positive: endothermic.”
findings.evidence: The draft’s own formula gives ΔE = products − reactants, so products below reactants means ΔE < 0. Source 5.6’s point-attaining answer states that when products are lower, “the overall energy change is negative, so the reaction is exothermic”; the draft’s Full-credit part (3) also says this correctly.
